metadata.author: Research Team
metadata.description: Proteus coding task with post-survey only

pre_survey.title: Pre-Study Survey
pre_survey.description: No pre-survey required for this assignment.

post_survey.title: Post-Study Survey
post_survey.description: Thank you for completing the task! Please share your experience with the AI coding assistant. All questions are required.

questions.question: Please answer the following questions with respect to the Coding Assistant you used to complete this assignment. Describe why you trust or distrust AI coding assistants in your own words.
questions.placeholder: Describe the factors that influenced your trust or distrust in the AI coding assistant during this assignment...

questions.question: Please describe in your own words, how you think this AI Coding Assistant generates code suggestions?
questions.placeholder: Explain your understanding of how this AI generates code suggestions...

questions.question: How accurate do you believe these AI Coding Assistant generated code suggestions are?
questions.help_text: Move the slider to indicate your perceived accuracy (0% = completely inaccurate, 100% = perfectly accurate)

questions.question: Share your overall experience with how the AI coding assistant helped or hindered you in solving the programming assignment.
questions.placeholder: Describe your overall experience with the AI assistant during this assignment...

questions.question: Seeing the AI guess (not just the next-line suggestion) was:
questions.help_text: 1 = Very unhelpful, 2 = Unhelpful, 3 = Neither helpful nor unhelpful, 4 = Helpful, 5 = Very helpful

questions.question: Explain whether or how you used the AI's guess during this activity.
questions.placeholder: Describe how you used (or didn't use) the AI's guess about your problem...

questions.question: Would you continue to use this tool, why or why not?
questions.placeholder: Explain whether you would use this tool again and your reasoning...

questions.question: How often was the AI's intention different from yours, and how did you interpret those misalignments?
questions.placeholder: Describe instances where the AI's understanding differed from yours and how you dealt with it...

questions.question: Has using this tool changed your view on how AI assistants work, and if so, why?
questions.placeholder: Reflect on whether and how your understanding of AI assistants has changed...

questions.question: What suggestions do you have for improving this tool?
questions.placeholder: Share your ideas for how this AI coding assistant could be improved...

questions.question: How difficult did you find this problem?
questions.help_text: 1 = Very easy, 2 = Easy, 3 = Moderate, 4 = Difficult, 5 = Very difficult
